{{Quote|The Dark Council runs blind. We alone oversee the Emperor's will in the galaxy.|Servant One|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] '''power base''' was a group of individuals and organizations that existed to serve the will of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in whatever fashion he desired. The twelve [[Servant]]s of the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] accomplished their master's will in secret across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], while the [[Imperial Guard]] protected their leader from harm with their lives. The position of [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Emperor's Voice]] allowed the Emperor to keep his true body safe from harm, while his [[Emperor's Wrath|Wrath]] brought the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler's fury upon his enemies and his [[Children of the Emperor|Children]] became his unknowing eyes and ears throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. all except one of the Emperor's servants were mentally bound to their master through the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and as such they were eternally loyal. The only exception is the Wrath, as Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] and his [[Empire's Wrath|successor]] were not bound by any rituals, as the Emperor requires his enforcer to use the full strength of their power.

After the Emperor's decimation of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the powerbase was abandoned as the Emperor had shifted his entire focus to Zakuul and revealed to the Alliance Commander that he no longer required Voices, Hands or children calling them crude vessels<ref name="A Dream of Empire">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=2}}</ref>.

[[Darth Marr]] reformed the Wrath into the Empire's Wrath where the individual retained their autonomy and power, as long as it was beneficial to the Empire, but were now answerable only to Marr, the defacto ruler of the Sith Empire.<ref name="sor">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref>

Years after Zakuul's conquest of the galaxy and it's subsequent defeat, the Sith Empire under [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]] retained the Imperial Guard as the Dark Honor Guard and were seen protecting the Dark Council and the Sith ruler.<ref name="kotet2">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] during the [[third Galactic War]], [[Darth Vowrawn|Emperor Vowrawn]] reformed the Emperor's Hand into the Hand of the Empire and it's members comprised of the Empire's elite led by [[Darth Rivix]] while out casting the [[Servant]]s from the organization and the Empire due to their loyalties.<ref name="Ons_imp_ending">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Objective Meridian}}</ref>
